title: PR proof comment manifest (manifest.json of the lh-proof-comment artifact)
description: Contract between the pull-request proof producers (pr-quality, pr-proof) and the base-branch commenter (.github/workflows/pr-proof-comment.yaml, scripts/ci/proof_comment.py). Every field is a claim: the commenter checks pr_number and head_sha against the GitHub API and ignores nothing it cannot verify. The enforcement is proof_comment.parse_manifest; a unit test keeps this file in step with it.

comments.description: One entry per sticky comment. The body is the file <kind>.md at the root of the artifact.

images.description: PNG files at images/<name> in the artifact. Only images a body references as ![alt](image:<name>) are ever published.

allowed_issue_refs.description: Issue or PR numbers a body may write as #N and have auto-linked (known-difference and gap links). Any other #N is neutralised.
